description: Medical oncology consult, one consult_draft entry. The specialty and note type are written into
the prompts; because note_type is consult, the assessment-and-plan standard asks for the
letrozole counselling (macro.letrozole_prescription_text.prompt). The test macro is appended
to the consult as its last line.

consult_draft: Margaret Okafor, 58, referred after a screening mammogram showed a 14 mm mass in the left breast. Core biopsy: invasive ductal carcinoma, grade 2, ER positive, HER2 negative. Letrozole 2.5 mg daily started today. (Fictional.)
